name: Stereo micro-shift
desc: One voice 9 cents up left, one 9 cents down right, 12 ms late, under the dry: wide rhythm guitar

refs.why: Eventide harmonizer pair detuned a few cents each way, blended with the dry

notes: detune × 25 ct: 0.36 = ±9 ct. The delay decorrelates the voices from the dry, so no chorus wobble; stereo lane needed
